title: T1090.002 — Proxy - External Proxy
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Proxy - External Proxy with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Renting the VPS
steps.caption: The attacker rents a small VPS from a hosting company. On it, they install a port redirector in the style of HTRAN. The redirector listens on one port and forwards all traffic to the attacker’s real C2 server.
steps.defender: nothing yet - the rental is private, but hosting ASNs are a known risk group.

steps.title: The first beacon
steps.caption: The implant on the victim workstation wakes up and beacons. The packet leaves through the company firewall on port 443 and lands on the VPS. The firewall logs a new outbound TLS flow.
steps.defender: a new flow to a hosting-ASN IP with no business reason is the first clue.

steps.title: Forwarded to C2
steps.caption: The redirector on the VPS forwards the beacon to the real C2 server. This leg never touches your network. No log inside your company can record it.
steps.defender: your logs stop at the proxy IP; everything after it is invisible.

steps.title: The reply comes back
steps.caption: The C2 server answers. The reply travels from C2 to the VPS, then back through your firewall to the implant. Commands now flow over the tunnel.
steps.defender: return traffic looks like ordinary TLS from a hosting IP.

steps.title: The blind spot in one picture
steps.caption: The SOC sees a steady flow from one workstation to one rare hosting IP. It cannot see what happens behind the VPS. The operator, the C2 address, and the protocols stay hidden.
steps.defender: treat any steady flow to a rare hosting IP as a question, not as noise.

steps.title: The bypass attempt
steps.caption: The implant tries to reach the C2 server directly. The egress policy denies the connection. The implant then falls back to the proxy path.
steps.defender: one denied direct flow to the C2 IP is a loud and useful clue.

detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Following the log trail
steps.caption: The analyst enriches the proxy IP with its ASN. It belongs to a hosting provider, and your business has no service there. The analyst checks which other hosts talk to the same ASN.
steps.defender: the trail shows only the proxy, but the ASN is a pivot point.

steps.title: Block and hunt
steps.caption: The team blocks the proxy IP and the whole hosting ASN at the firewall. They hunt the same beacon pattern across all hosts to find other victims.
steps.defender: block the relay, then hunt - rotation means more proxies may already exist.
